note: Immutable P0 remains historical evidence. P2 rule migrations are append-only and are verified against the PR base: each source occurrence must exist in its declared base layer (null means unlayered), only unlayered sources reduce P0 debt, every destination must be explicitly layered in the same stylesheet, declarations must be preserved as an ordered lossless 1-to-1 or 1-to-many partition, and exact selector/property conflicts are recorded separately for normal and important declarations. Keyframe and runtime-style migrations remain disabled until their own contracts are implemented.
